# Pfizer

> > Pfizer is a premier biopharmaceutical company advancing breakthrough therapies in immunology, gene therapy, oncology, and vaccines through world-class R&D and clinical trials.

Pfizer develops life-changing medicines and vaccines while fostering scientific innovation through postdoctoral training programs, MBA leadership development, and early career opportunities. The company maintains rigorous clinical trial standards, transparent grant reporting, and a strong commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion across its global operations.

## Key Topics

- Immunology & Inflammation
- Gene Therapy
- Clinical Trials
- Postdoctoral Training Programs
- Drug Development Pipeline
- Diversity & Inclusion (DEI)
- MBA Summer Associate Program
- Biopharmaceutical Research
- Vaccine Manufacturing
- Scientific Mentorship
- Early Career Development
- Medical Education Grants
- Breakthrough Fellowship Program
- Digital Innovation & Hackathons
- Oncology & Rare Diseases

## Research & Development

- [Immunology & Inflammation: Autoimmune Pipeline & Trials](https://www.pfizer.com/science/focus-areas/immunology-inflammation/pipeline): Immunology pipeline with autoimmune clinical trials and drug development
- [Change lives for generations to come](https://www.pfizer.com/about/careers/en-id/research-and-development): R&D careers in gene therapy, vaccines, oncology, and rare diseases
- [Sangamo and Pfizer Announce Updated Phase 1/2 Results](https://www.pfizer.com/news/press-release/press-release-detail/sangamo_and_pfizer_announce_updated_phase_1_2_results_showing_sustained_increased_factor_viii_activity_through_44_weeks_following_sb_525_gene_therapy_treatment): SB-525 gene therapy Phase 1/2 results for hemophilia A treatment
- [PGS Sanford, NC](https://www.pfizer.com/products/pfizer-global-supply/us-manufacturing-sites/sanford): Sanford NC biotechnology hub for vaccines and gene therapy manufacturing

## Clinical Trials & Transparency

- [Plain Language Study Results Summaries](https://www.pfizer.com/science/clinical-trials/plain-language-study-results-summaries): Patient-friendly clinical trial results summaries and layperson guides
- [Payment and Reimbursement to Study Participants](https://www.pfizer.com/science/clinical-trials/integrity-and-transparency/payment-reimbursement-participants): Clinical trial participant compensation and reimbursement policies
- [Pfizer Medical, Scientific & Patient Education Grant Transparency](https://www.pfizer.com/about/programs-policies/transparency-in-grants): Medical education funding, grants, and charitable contributions disclosure

## Diversity & Inclusion

- [Diversity and Inclusion](https://www.pfizer.com/about/responsibility/diversity-and-inclusion): DEI strategy, EEO reporting, and workplace culture initiatives
- [Diversity & Inclusion (EN-MS)](https://www.pfizer.com/about/careers/en-ms/diversity-inclusion): Workplace equity, opportunity parity, and EEO-1 disclosure commitments
- [Diversity & Inclusion (EN-SI)](https://www.pfizer.com/about/careers/en-si/diversity-inclusion): DEI goals, representation targets, and EEOC reporting standards

## Career Development Programs

- [Postdoctoral Program (EN-GB)](https://www.pfizer.com/about/careers/en-gb/postdoctoral-program): R&D postdoctoral training program with scientific mentorship
- [Postdoctoral Program (EN-ID)](https://www.pfizer.com/about/careers/en-id/postdoctoral-program): Postdoctoral fellowship program for biopharmaceutical research
- [MBA Summer Associate Program (EN-TW)](https://www.pfizer.com/about/careers/en-tw/mba-summer-associate-program): MBA summer internship for leadership development at top business schools
- [MBA Summer Associate Program (EN-ZA)](https://www.pfizer.com/about/careers/en-za/mba-summer-associate-program): MBA summer associate program for future Pfizer leaders
- [Opportunities for Early Careers](https://www.pfizer.com/about/careers/es-ca/early-careers): Early career programs including fellowships, rotations, and hackathons
- [Opportunities for Pre-College](https://www.pfizer.com/about/careers/en-si/opportunities-pre-college): Pre-college programs including Girls Who Code and Digital For Girls

## Optional

- [Postdoctoral Program (DE-AT)](https://www.pfizer.com/about/careers/de-at/postdoctoral-program): Postdoctoral research training program (German/Austrian localization)
- [Careers (KO)](https://www.pfizer.com/about/careers/ko/diversity-inclusion): Diversity and inclusion in Pfizer careers (Korean localization)
- [Submit Your Opportunities](https://www.pfizer.com/about/partners/submit-your-opportunities): Business development and partnering opportunities submission portal
